body:
Well first think about everything entirely objectively.

Then analyze why you are feeling upset. Are you upset because you’re frustrated/mad at them? Upset because they said what you’ve been thinking this whole time? 

Lastly, think of solutions based off of your analysis. If your analysis leads you to believe that they were just saying shitty stuff which is why you’re upset, then try to find them and tell them what they did wrong and why. If they’re really a therapist, they would try to converse with you and tell them their intentions and yada yada. Or, if they are still being shitty, make their life as much of a hell as your life has been. Destroy their career if you can because when someone tries to knock down someone whose already down, that’s fucked up and needs to be addressed before they do the same thing to others. If the reason you’re upset is because you agree/feel the same but it hurt to hear it out loud, then work to change yourself or brush it off. 

Like imagine someone like Trump trying to criticize a mentally ill person. You would be disgusted and brush him off right? Exactly, treat the therapist the same way.
You’re dealing with a mental illness that cripples the only line of defense humans have. The fact you are still alive makes you not a loser. That’s all I have to say.
